intro: CAVA Tomato + Onion is a fresh and flavorful topping that adds bright, garden-fresh taste to any bowl or pita. This complimentary addition from the [CAVA Toppings Menu](/menu/toppings) features diced ripe tomatoes paired with sweet onions for a classic Mediterranean combination. At just 20 calories, it delivers crisp texture and vibrant flavor to customize your meal from the [full CAVA menu](/). Perfect for those seeking fresh vegetable toppings without extra cost.
priceCalories: CAVA Tomato + Onion is included with your order at no additional charge, making it an excellent value topping choice. This fresh vegetable combination contains only 20 calories per serving, allowing you to add flavor and nutrition without significantly impacting your daily caloric intake. The complimentary pricing makes it easy to load up on fresh toppings when building your custom bowl or pita at CAVA.
whatMakesSpecial: What sets CAVA Tomato + Onion apart is the quality of ingredients and perfect balance of flavors. The tomatoes are diced at peak ripeness for maximum sweetness and juiciness, while the sweet onions provide a mild, aromatic bite without overpowering sharpness. This classic pairing adds both visual appeal and fresh Mediterranean flavor to any creation on the [CAVA Curated Bowls Menu](/menu/curated-bowls) or custom build.
nutritionFacts: Each serving of Tomato + Onion contains 20 calories with a balanced macronutrient profile of 0g protein, 2g carbohydrates, and 1.5g fat. The minimal calorie count makes it an ideal choice for those monitoring their intake while still wanting fresh vegetable toppings. Use the [CAVA Nutrition Calculator](/calculator) to see how this topping fits into your complete meal and dietary goals.
whatsInside: CAVA Tomato + Onion features just two simple, wholesome ingredients: diced ripe tomatoes and sweet onions. The tomatoes are carefully selected for optimal ripeness and flavor, then diced to the perfect size for easy eating. The sweet onions are chosen specifically for their mild, pleasant flavor that complements rather than overwhelms. No artificial preservatives, additives, or unnecessary ingredients are included in this fresh topping.
tasteLike: CAVA Tomato + Onion delivers a refreshing burst of garden-fresh flavors with every bite. The ripe tomatoes provide juicy sweetness with subtle acidity, while the sweet onions add a mild, aromatic crunch. Together, they create a classic Mediterranean taste profile that enhances without overpowering your [CAVA Bases Menu](/menu/bases) or protein choices. The combination offers both cool freshness and natural vegetable sweetness.
customize: Maximize your Tomato + Onion topping by pairing it with complementary items from the [CAVA Dressings Menu](/menu/dressings) like Red Pepper Hummus or Lemon Herb Tahini. Layer it over greens from the bases menu for a salad-style bowl, or combine with Pita Crisps for added crunch. The mild flavor profile makes it versatile enough to complement any protein choice or dressing combination you select.
pairsWell: This topping pairs exceptionally well with Shredded Romaine for a classic salad base, Pita Crisps for textural contrast, and Persian Cucumber for additional fresh crunch. It also complements Sumac Cabbage Slaw beautifully, creating a diverse vegetable medley. The fresh flavors work perfectly alongside grilled proteins and creamy dips from the [CAVA Dips & Spreads Menu](/menu/dips-spreads), enhancing Mediterranean-inspired flavor profiles throughout your meal.
healthyChoice: Tomato + Onion is an excellent healthy choice for nutrition-conscious diners. At only 20 calories with 2g of carbs and minimal fat, it adds essential vitamins and antioxidants without dietary burden. Tomatoes provide lycopene and vitamin C, while onions offer quercetin and other beneficial compounds. This topping supports various dietary preferences and is naturally vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free, making it accessible to most dietary needs.
howToOrder: To order Tomato + Onion at CAVA, simply request it as a topping when building your custom bowl or pita. Staff will add a generous portion to your order at no extra charge. You can ask for light, regular, or extra portions based on your preference. The topping is available at all [CAVA Locations](/locations) and can be combined with unlimited other complimentary toppings for a fully customized meal.
vsAlternatives: Compared to other fresh vegetable toppings, Tomato + Onion offers a classic flavor profile that appeals to most palates. While Persian Cucumber provides more crunch at 15 calories and Sumac Cabbage Slaw delivers tang at 30 calories, Tomato + Onion strikes a perfect balance of sweetness and savory notes. Unlike heavier toppings, it adds moisture and freshness without overwhelming your bowl or requiring compatibility concerns with dressings.
whoShouldTry: Everyone from first-time CAVA visitors to regular guests should try Tomato + Onion. It is ideal for those who appreciate fresh vegetables, Mediterranean flavors, or classic topping combinations. Perfect for calorie-conscious diners seeking maximum flavor with minimal nutritional impact. Those following plant-based diets will appreciate the fresh vegetable option, while anyone building a custom creation will find it enhances virtually any combination from the menu.
worthTrying: CAVA Tomato + Onion is absolutely worth trying as a standard addition to your order. The complimentary pricing means there is no financial risk, while the fresh quality and classic flavor combination deliver consistent satisfaction. At just 20 calories, you can enjoy the bright, garden-fresh taste without dietary concerns. The versatility to pair with any bowl or pita creation makes it a reliable choice that enhances your CAVA experience every time.

faqs.q: How many calories are in CAVA Tomato + Onion?
faqs.a: CAVA Tomato + Onion contains 20 calories per serving with 0g protein, 2g carbohydrates, and 1.5g fat. This minimal calorie count makes it an excellent choice for adding fresh vegetable flavor without significantly impacting your daily caloric intake or macronutrient goals.

faqs.q: Is CAVA Tomato + Onion included in the base price?
faqs.a: Yes, CAVA Tomato + Onion is included with your order at no additional charge. It is one of several complimentary toppings available when building your custom bowl or pita, allowing you to add fresh vegetables and enhance your meal without extra cost.

faqs.q: What ingredients are in CAVA Tomato + Onion?
faqs.a: CAVA Tomato + Onion contains just two simple ingredients: diced ripe tomatoes and sweet onions. There are no artificial preservatives, additives, or complex ingredients, making it a clean and wholesome fresh vegetable topping option for any dietary preference.

faqs.q: Is CAVA Tomato + Onion gluten-free and vegan?
faqs.a: Yes, CAVA Tomato + Onion is naturally gluten-free and vegan. The topping consists only of fresh vegetables without any animal products or gluten-containing ingredients, making it suitable for various dietary restrictions and preferences including vegetarian, vegan, and gluten-free diets.

faqs.q: What does CAVA Tomato + Onion pair well with?
faqs.a: CAVA Tomato + Onion pairs well with Shredded Romaine, Pita Crisps, Persian Cucumber, and Sumac Cabbage Slaw. It complements all proteins and works beautifully with creamy dips and dressings, making it a versatile topping that enhances virtually any bowl or pita combination you create.
